items: [State] each entry records its expiry time (insert time + ttl)
[State] recency order is tracked per key
[insert] inserting an existing key replaces the value, restarts its life and makes it most recent
[insert] when full, expired entries are dropped before any live entry
[insert] only if none expired, the least recently used live entry is evicted
[get] an expired entry returns `None` and is removed
[get] a live hit makes the key most recent but does not extend its life
